conbody.p: Unmarking a clause removes clause properties and returns the text to a static state. If you need to unmark a clause during the same session in which you marked it, you can use the Doc Clauses pane to remove clause properties. Note that, if you chose to replace the text with a clause from the library, you cannot choose to unmark the clause, it can only be deleted.
Mark the static text in the agreement document as a clause in the same session using Clause Library.
